meta.label: Skills
meta.description: Trailbound skill professions with focused subskills and shared common skills. Canon entries come from For Review/Skills.md; generated entries expand coverage from the GDD, Oregon Trail survival fantasy, and D&D 5e skill/ability framing. Sphere-grid layout lives in a separate JSON later — skills only list possible node ideas.
schemaNotes: description: required short summary of what the skill covers
subskills: expertise branches within a profession
commonSkillIds: shared attributes that can be trained via this profession
skillTypes.passive / skillTypes.active: always-on vs player-triggered expressions
possibleGridNodes: workshop list of node ideas for a future sphere-grid file (type: branch|passive|active|common-link|motif|gateway|milestone|design-note)
influences.oregonTrail / influences.dnd5e: separate design lenses — not 1:1 ports
tags: free-form labels for search/filter (always include 'generated' on AI drafts)

records.name: Cooking
records.description: Prepare meals from camp stores and POI ingredients. Minigame performance shapes attributes like doneness, seasoning, and perceived quality rather than a single 0–100 score.

subskills.name: Baking
subskills.description: Breads, pastries, and oven-controlled recipes.

subskills.name: Grilling
subskills.description: Direct-heat cooking; heat and timing set doneness attributes.

subskills.name: Butchery
subskills.description: Breakdown of game and livestock into usable cuts and byproducts.

subskills.name: Brewing
subskills.description: Ferments, teas, and trail beverages with shelf-life tradeoffs.

passive: Ration yield floor — leftovers and scrap stretch further
Spoilage foresight — better estimate when stores will turn
Preference memory — remember party doneness/taste likes
active: Cook meal (Mess Kit / Stoke the Hearth chains)
Preserve batch — smoke, salt, or pickle for the road

oregonTrail.lens: Rations, hunting meat conversion, and the daily pressure of feeding the party before miles resume.
beats: Ration modes (filling / meager / bare) as cooking-efficiency tradeoffs

Trading post ingredients as rare recipe unlocks

dnd5e.lens: Cook's utensils as tool proficiency; Constitution-adjacent endurance for long kitchen days; Wisdom for taste/judgment.
beats: Treat recipes like 'prepared' options for the day
Passive 'kitchen sense' akin to Passive Perception for doneness
